info.title: Tilawah API
info.description: Versioned REST API shared by the Tilawah website and mobile app. All responses are JSON. Errors use ErrorResponse. Authentication endpoints (sign-in, sign-up, sign-out, password reset, OAuth) are provided by Better Auth under /api/auth and are not part of this document.

RecitationSort.description: popular = all-time plays; trending = plays in the last 7 days.

Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor (base64url). Pass back unchanged with the same filters and sort.

ObjectId.description: MongoDB ObjectId as 24 lowercase hex characters.

durationSec.description: Read by the client from the audio metadata.

UpdateRecitationBody.description: Owners may change any field. If a non-verified owner changes surah, ayah range or riwayah of an approved recitation, it returns to pending.

contentType.description: One of: audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, audio/ogg, audio/webm.

rightsConfirmed.description: "This is my own recitation or I have permission to share it." Must be true.

recitationIds.description: Ordered list, at most 200. Replaces the whole list.
Ordered list, at most 200. Replaces the whole list.

UpdateMeBody.description: Email, password and image changes go through Better Auth (/api/auth/*).

SwitchModeBody.description: Switching to reciter the first time sets reciterSince and makes the reciter profile public. Switching back to listener keeps the profile and its recitations public. No new sign-in is needed.

AccountMode.description: Which side of the app the user is in. Saved on the account, so web and app agree.

resolveReports.description: Mark open reports on this recitation as actioned.

RecitationDecisionBody.description: approve: pending|rejected → approved. reject: pending → rejected. remove: pending|approved → removed. Other transitions return CONFLICT.

Role.description: user is the default for new accounts.

UpdateUserBody.description: role changes staff permissions. Setting verifiedReciter to true also turns on the reciter profile if it is off. An admin cannot change their own role.

HealthResponse.description: If the database is unreachable the endpoint returns 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Human-readable, English. Not for display logic.

juz.description: Juz numbers this surah spans, ascending.

recitations.description: First page of approved recitations. Continue with GET /recitations?surah=n.

ReciterSummary.description: Public view of the user who uploaded a recitation.

expiresAt.description: When the signed URL stops working. null for permanent public URLs. Refetch the recitation to get a fresh URL.

ViewerState.description: Present only when the request is authenticated.

nextCursor.description: null when there are no more items.

bismillah.description: The bismillah shown above the surah, separated from ayah 1. null for surah 9; for surah 1 it is ayah 1 itself, so also null.

text.description: Exact Tanzil Uthmani text of the ayah.

TextSource.description: Attribution required by the Tanzil license. Clients must display it.

n.description: Book (kitab) number; 0 is Sahih Muslim’s introduction.

first.description: First hadith number in this book.

nextCursor.description: null when there are no more items.

number.description: Hadith number (a few have a sub-number, e.g. 402.2).

ur.description: null where the source has no Urdu text.

nextCursor.description: null when there are no more items.

moderationNote.description: Reason given on reject or remove.

counted.description: false when this listener already counted a play recently.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned R2 URL. PUT the raw file bytes here.

headers.description: Headers the PUT must send exactly, including Content-Type.

uploadToken.description: Signed token describing this upload. Send it to POST /recitations to confirm.

nextCursor.description: null when there are no more items.

ReciterProfile.description: Visible once the user has turned on reciter mode (reciterSince is set); otherwise 404, so listener-only accounts are never exposed.

nextCursor.description: null when there are no more items.

recitations.description: In playlist order. Recitations that are no longer approved are left out.

reciterSince.description: When the user first switched to reciter mode, which turned on their public reciter profile. null if never.

verifiedReciter.description: Badge granted by moderators/admins. Verified uploads skip the review queue.

likes.description: Liked recitations, most recently liked first.

nextCursor.description: null when there are no more items.

MyRecitationPage.description: The caller’s own uploads in every status, newest first.

moderationNote.description: Reason given on reject or remove.

storageBytes.description: Audio stored for recitations that are not removed.

nextCursor.description: null when there are no more items.

reciterSince.description: When the user first switched to reciter mode, which turned on their public reciter profile. null if never.

verifiedReciter.description: Badge granted by moderators/admins. Verified uploads skip the review queue.

AdminUser.description: An account as admins see it, with its recitation counts.
